title: verif-harness config
description: Per-project configuration for the verif-harness skill. Lives at <project-root>/.harness-config.json.

project_name.description: Short project identifier. Used in generated doc titles.

root.description: Directory containing RTL sources, project-root-relative. E.g., 'rtl/'.

top_module.description: SystemVerilog/Verilog module name of the DUT top. E.g., 'demo_fifo'.

top_file.description: Project-root-relative path to the file containing the DUT top module.

docs_root.description: Directory holding all verification-side markdown docs. E.g., 'sim/docs/'.

verification_subdir.description: Subdirectory under docs_root for verification plans.

governance_subdir.description: Subdirectory under docs_root for workflow governance.

root.description: Directory of pre-existing RTL design docs, or null if none.

spec_path.description: Absolute path to the upstream reference model spec markdown, or null if none.
